statements.sql: select * from `users` where `id` = 1 limit 1
select `value`, `name` from `configs` where `team_id` is null or `team_id` = 1
select * from `model_has_roles` where `model_id` = 1 and `model_type` = 'User'
select * from `teams` where `teams`.`id` = 1 limit 1
select * from `periods` where `periods`.`team_id` = 1

select `permissions`.*, `model_has_permissions`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_permissions`.`permission_id` as `pivot_permission_id`, `model_has_permissions`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type`, `model_has_permissions`.`team_id` as `pivot_team_id` from `permissions` inner join `model_has_permissions` on `permissions`.`id` = `model_has_permissions`.`permission_id` where `model_has_permissions`.`team_id` = 1 and `model_has_permissions`.`model_id` in (1) and `model_has_permissions`.`model_type` = 'User'

select `roles`.*, `model_has_roles`.`model_id` as `pivot_model_id`, `model_has_roles`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id`, `model_has_roles`.`model_type` as `pivot_model_type`, `model_has_roles`.`team_id` as `pivot_team_id` from `roles` inner join `model_has_roles` on `roles`.`id` = `model_has_roles`.`role_id` where `model_has_roles`.`team_id` = 1 and (`roles`.`team_id` is null or `roles`.`team_id` = 1) and `model_has_roles`.`model_id` in (1) and `model_has_roles`.`model_type` = 'User'

select count('id') as total from `students` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where `students`.`period_id` is null and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') limit 1

select count('id') as total from `students` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where `students`.`period_id` is null and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') and `admissions`.`joining_date` = `students`.`start_date` limit 1
select count('id') as total from `employees` where `employees`.`team_id` = 1 and `type` in ('administrative', 'teaching') limit 1
select count('id') as total from `employees` where `employees`.`team_id` = 1 limit 1

select `students`.`id`, `students`.`uuid`, `students`.`batch_id`, `students`.`period_id`, `students`.`contact_id`, `students`.`fee_structure_id`, `students`.`start_date`, `students`.`end_date`, `students`.`cancelled_at`, `contacts`.`team_id`, `contacts`.`user_id`, `students`.`meta` from `students` inner join `contacts` on `students`.`contact_id` = `contacts`.`id` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where `contacts`.`team_id` = 1 and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') and `students`.`period_id` is null
select * from `student_attendances` where 0 = 1 and `date` = '2026-11-07' and `subject_id` is null and `session` = 'first' and `is_default` = 1
select * from `options` where `team_id` = 1 and `type` = 'student_attendance_type' order by `position` asc

select SUM(student_fees.total) as total_fee, SUM(student_fees.paid) as paid_fee, SUM(student_fees.total - student_fees.paid) as balance_fee, SUM((SELECT SUM(concession) FROM student_fee_records WHERE student_fee_records.student_fee_id = student_fees.id)) as concession_fee from `students` left join `student_fees` on `students`.`id` = `student_fees`.`student_id` where `students`.`period_id` is null limit 1

select SUM(CASE WHEN date = '2026-11-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as today_collection, SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as week_collection, SUM(CASE WHEN date BETWEEN '2026-10-08' AND '2026-11-07' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as month_collection from `transactions` inner join `periods` on `periods`.`id` = `transactions`.`period_id` where `type` = 'receipt' and `periods`.`team_id` = 1 and ((`transactions`.`is_online` = 0 or (`transactions`.`is_online` = 1 and `processed_at` is not null)) and `transactions`.`cancelled_at` is null and `transactions`.`rejected_at` is null) limit 1

select `courses`.`id` as `course_id`, `courses`.`name` as `course_name`, `courses`.`term` as `course_term`, `contacts`.`gender`, COUNT(students.id) as student_count from `courses` left join `batches` on `courses`.`id` = `batches`.`course_id` left join `students` on `batches`.`id` = `students`.`batch_id` left join `contacts` on `students`.`contact_id` = `contacts`.`id` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where exists (select * from `divisions` where `courses`.`division_id` = `divisions`.`id` and `period_id` is null) and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') group by `courses`.`id`, `courses`.`name`, `courses`.`term`, `contacts`.`gender` order by `courses`.`position` asc

select `courses`.`name` as `course_name`, `courses`.`term` as `course_term`, COUNT(students.id) as student_count from `courses` left join `batches` on `courses`.`id` = `batches`.`course_id` left join `students` on `batches`.`id` = `students`.`batch_id` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where exists (select * from `divisions` where `courses`.`division_id` = `divisions`.`id` and `period_id` is null) and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') group by `courses`.`id`, `courses`.`name`, `courses`.`term` order by `courses`.`position` asc

select `courses`.`name` as `course_name`, `courses`.`term` as `course_term`, COUNT(students.id) as student_count from `courses` left join `batches` on `courses`.`id` = `batches`.`course_id` left join `students` on `batches`.`id` = `students`.`batch_id` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where exists (select * from `divisions` where `courses`.`division_id` = `divisions`.`id` and `period_id` is null) and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') and `admissions`.`joining_date` = `students`.`start_date` group by `courses`.`id`, `courses`.`name`, `courses`.`term` order by `courses`.`position` asc

select `course_id`, COUNT(*) as total, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'initiated' THEN 1 END) as initiated, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 END) as pending, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) as approved, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'rejected' THEN 1 END) as rejected from `registrations` inner join `courses` on `courses`.`id` = `registrations`.`course_id` where `period_id` is null and `course_id` is not null group by `course_id` order by `courses`.`position` asc

select MONTH(date) as month, SUM(CASE WHEN type = "receipt" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as receipt, SUM(CASE WHEN type = "payment" THEN amount ELSE 0 END) as payment from `transactions` where exists (select * from `periods` where `transactions`.`period_id` = `periods`.`id` and `team_id` = 1) and `type` in ('receipt', 'payment') and `date` between '2025-12-01' and '2026-11-30' and `transactions`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`is_online` = 0 or (`is_online` = 1 and `transactions`.`processed_at` is not null)) group by `month` order by `month` asc

select count('id') as total from `students` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where `students`.`period_id` is null and `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') limit 1

select service_allocations.type, COUNT(service_allocations.id) as total from `service_allocations` inner join `students` on `students`.`id` = `service_allocations`.`model_id` inner join `admissions` on `admissions`.`id` = `students`.`admission_id` where `students`.`cancelled_at` is null and (`admissions`.`leaving_date` is null or `admissions`.`leaving_date` > '2026-11-07') and `students`.`period_id` is null and `service_allocations`.`type` in ('mess', 'transport', 'hostel') group by `service_allocations`.`type`
